scientific_integrity: The new result is a sharp triple-progression correlation theorem, not a new Lucas congruence or digit-divisibility criterion. The proof gives a complete eight-state superharmonic certificate and strict equality classification.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to fifth-adic nondivisibility in the third binomial-power (Franel) sequence and fixed positive shifts. Historical priority not independently certified; no full all-shift correlation spectrum is asserted.
title: Sharp three-term progression overlap among five-nondivisible Franel indices
